notes.title: Patch 03/01/2024
notes.content:
"Disable Shaders" option added 

For players with an older video card the Vulkan API can create the following error:

"USER ERROR: Vulkan: Cannot submit graphics queue. Error code: VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST"

Which results in the game freezing.

If you have an older videocard and and are experiencing this issue you can use the "disable shaders" option to prevent this from happening.

notes.title: Patch 25/12/2024
notes.content:
Bug Fix "Curse of Corruption"
When playing on cursed difficulty you are now able to select a negative effect at the "Curse of corruption" screen after defeating the boss of Act 1.

Happy Holidays and wishing everyone a wonderful New Year.

notes.title: Seal the Rift is out now
notes.content:
We are proud to present Seal the Rift.

A big thank you to all our Early Access players. Your support and feedback has been invaluable.

We hope you enjoy the adventure we’ve crafted and look forward to hearing your thoughts.

notes.title: Patch 06/09/2024
notes.content:
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
    [*]We have reviewed and re-balanced every enemy in the game.
[/list]

The goal is that the game is challenging but beatable on Normal Difficulty. 

Frustrating levels of difficulty can be found on "Cursed Difficulty". You will need knowledge, skill and luck to brave this difficulty.

notes.content:
